text: The drag looks like it would resolve but then it doesnt change anything it doesnt re-order it doesnt go into a group, none of that. or if it is updating, then react is no rerendering it. everything else seems to be good
resolution: Fixed the drop no-op at its real boundary: model.outliner.move was registered and previewed in React, but the native metadata-journal door rejected the unknown outliner.move action before AppFrame could commit state. Centralized metadata action labels in the testable journal module, admitted outliner.move, added a Zig regression covering the complete host whitelist, and rebuilt the ReleaseFast editor successfully.
